journal.note: v016 changes the brush rule: the horizontal wet-route field becomes a finite pressure plate. A bounded drag cuts the plate, cells on both sides pivot and lift, and displaced material gathers into a ridge; lifting the latest cut reconstructs the exact prior plate.

critiques.argument: The pressure cut must be carried by actual plate geometry: cells on both sides need to pivot, lift, and change their grain, while the ridge follows the visitor's path. A dark incision drawn over an unchanged grid is not material memory.

With labels, controls, readout, and ridge witnesses hidden, a viewer should find a singular plate/object, a finite incision, two lifted banks, and a displaced ridge. If it reads as another bundle of horizontal routes, the medium switch fails.

A drag must be causally different from a click: path shape and pressure must alter the cut width and displaced geometry. Enter/Space may provide an equivalent deterministic cut, and lifting only the latest cut must restore the exact preceding plate.

A fracture is an easy metaphor. Delete v016 if the ridge is decorative, if edge-to-edge drags do not alter the plate materially, if speed/path length has no consequence, or if prose carries more force than the blind object can show.

source.title: p5.brush
source.observedMechanism: Natural drawing tools are treated as programmable instruments: pressure, density, grain, directional behaviour, fills, and vector fields alter how geometry is produced rather than being a skin applied after geometry.
source.translatedRule: In the Brush current, pressure becomes a topological event: a bounded drag cuts a finite plate, changes both banks' cell angle, lift, grain, edge, and pigment, and forces displaced matter to gather into a ridge.
source.visibleConsequence: The blind field becomes a singular pressure-shaped plate/object with a finite incision, two lifted banks, and a path-following ridge instead of horizontal wet routes.
source.falsifier: If caption-free viewing sees only a grid with a dark line, or if cells and ridge geometry remain unchanged, the material translation fails.
source.antiCopy: No p5.brush brushes, watercolor appearance, hatching vocabulary, palette, compositions, or API surface is reproduced.
source.directionConsequence: Closes the Brush current's v013-v015 continuous route grammar and opens a cut-object grammar: pressure, fracture, lifted matter, and a drag-shaped viewer task.

decision.nextMutation: Run an independent caption-free comparison with plate, incision, ridge, labels, controls, and readout hidden; delete v016 if the singular pressure plate is not legible as a medium switch from v013-v015.
